changelog:
Polymarket Autopilot v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Automated market monitoring and trend tracking for Polymarket.
- AI-driven data analysis, including technical indicators and sentiment.
- Auto-execution of trading strategies with risk management controls.
- Portfolio management with real-time P&L reporting.
- Automated and manual trade/report triggers.
- Discord integration for trade signals, daily reports, and alerts.
summary: Automated paper trading on Polymarket using AI agents. Monitors trends, manages portfolio, and executes trades based on strategies.
